title: Image refill 002 — Nasarawa State
scope: Image refill for existing Nasarawa State records: heritage places, the state capital, cultural records and peoples (plus the Igbo and Fulani, whose home states are not researched yet). No history changed.
gaps: No photograph on Wikimedia Commons (searched "Keana salt", "Keana", "salt Nasarawa"). Non-free candidate: The Sun, "Keana: Untapped Nasarawa salt mining industry", https://thesun.ng/keana-untapped-nasarawa-salt-mining-industry/ (permission needed).
No photograph on Wikimedia Commons (searched "National Museum Lafia", "Lafia").
No photograph on Wikimedia Commons. Non-free candidate: NAN report on the 2025 National Oyarore Salt Festival, https://api.nannews.ng/?p=2416 (permission needed).
No photograph of the Odu festival of Doma on Wikimedia Commons or found on the web (web results were other festivals: the Igbo Odo, the Ijebu Ojude Oba).
No photograph of the Alago on Wikimedia Commons (results were Alagón, Spain, and an Alago statue in Abeokuta).
No photograph of the Migili (Koro Lafia) on Wikimedia Commons.

No photograph of the Kantana people. Museum Mangam masks on Commons are labelled "Kantana/Kulere" (Musée du quai Branly, Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 3.0) — attribution split between two peoples, so held for manual review rather than used.

1960s Fulani photographs by Aylette Jenness (Smithsonian EEPA) are on Commons tagged PD-Nigeria, but the photographer is American and the licence basis is doubtful — held for manual review, not used. No other suitable free photo checked yet.
